review_candidates.title: Deloitte Innovation Hub | Cloud & DevOps Engineering Senior Technical Lead, Cairo, Egypt

remote_eligibility.note: Generic company words such as 'worldwide' do not count without remote-work context.

review_candidates.description_excerpt: Deloitte innovation hub (DIH) is a strategic initiative established to support our ambition to become the leading business transformation partner of choice for our clients and to expand and scale our delivery footprint across EMEA. Connect to your opportunity Work with a team to realize the ultimate solution for infrastructure and network configuration/automation and deployment for AWS/GCP/Azure. Contribute to build and deploy automation support (CI/CD) in AWS/GCP/Azure. Develop infrastructure as code and testable infrastructure in AWS/GCP/Azure. Focus on reducing technical lead time for infra and network for all DevOps teams.
